plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 AD-lesional, 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch) are QC'd for sample structure with special attention to sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) before any exclusion decision, then tested for differential expression with DESeq2 (Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, BH-FDR with independent filtering at alpha=0.05), and the full ranked gene list is used for preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets to identify pathway-level changes. A final report step consolidates DE genes, pathway hits, diagnostics, and the sample_01 handling decision with full reproducibility record.
